mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of integrating indoor and outdoor living spaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Integrating indoor and outdoor living spaces offers several benefits, especially in regions like Los Angeles with favorable climates. It maximizes usable living area by extending interiors outward, improves natural light and ventilation, and enhances the connection to nature. This design promotes a sense of openness and freedom, contributing to a more relaxed and expansive home environment. For homeowners, it can increase property value and provide versatile spaces for entertaining, relaxation, and everyday living, adapting to various activities and seasons.
